note: Adult (>=50 kg, no organ impairment) outpatient daily-dose ceilings, mg/day. Advisory only — the aggregation flag is a prompt to check the combined molecule load across co-prescribed products, not a hard contraindication. Seed set = paracetamol + the NSAIDs and decongestant stimulants that recur in Indian fever/pain combination brands, plus metformin (1.2). 1.1 (Deterministic-Citations PRD §5.6, V-signed-off 22 Jul): each entry carries `derivation` ('external' = corpus-verified, resolves to a published authority; 'llm' = internally-derived, no corpus verification) and, where external, a `citation` to the underlying source. 1.2 (PRD CDMSS-PHARMACY-ROUND1, Dr Khatija round-1 sign-off, 25 Jul 2026): a third derivation 'clinician' (a NAMED clinician signed the threshold — carries signed_by/signed_on, routes to the clinician_signed tier, never internal_consensus); all ten existing ceilings endorsed as written (Khatija Q1, closes register D-3) and now carry the signature; aceclofenac + mefenamic acid move llm→clinician; naproxen gains first_day_max_mg_per_day (1250 mg on day one of acute use, Decision 5); etoricoxib default tightened 120→90 with indication_conditional gout=120 (Decision 6); metformin 3000 added (Decision 7/8 — the ONE-entry replacement for the mono+FDC duplication build). NOTE these are ADVISORY thresholds — a citation records where a concordant threshold was found; several external entries were marked 'contradicts' by the strict verifier because the corpus states a DIFFERENT (usually higher, indication-specific) maximum, which is a claim-granularity artifact, not a data defect (V ruling). citation/derivation/signature are additive metadata; they never enter scoring.

limits.note: 3000 mg/day adult ceiling (Decision 7/8, Khatija 25 Jul). Adding this entry enables duplicate-molecule detection across FDCs (mono + fixed-dose combination): with no ceiling the molecule was invisible to the aggregation, so a mono + FDC stack never surfaced. Within-ceiling stacking now shows as informational (confidence 0, non-scoring); a genuine >3 g stack scores. This ONE entry replaces the mono+FDC class-duplication rule (measured over 30 days: all 5 real co-prescriptions total 1000–2000 mg/day and stay within the ceiling — the class rule would have misfired on 4 of 5).
limits.signed_by: Dr Khatija, Chief Clinical Pharmacologist, Even
